info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Model By Param1-spec
info.description: The Update Production Risk Model API enables the adjustment of existing production risk models based on specific parameters. This operation allows users to modify elements of a model using a unique identifier, enhancing the adaptability of the model to changing risk scenarios. Typical consumers of this API include risk management teams and data analysts looking to fine-tune model parameters for improved accuracy. With this functionality, organizations can ensure their risk assessment models remain relevant and effective in their decision-making processes.

patch.summary: Update a specific production risk model.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific production risk model identified by its unique ID. The update involves sending a patch request with the necessary modifications to the resource.
